prompts.title: The Cafe Window
prompts.prompt:
Use the uploaded image strictly only for the woman’s facial identity and natural features. Preserve her face shape, facial proportions, eyes, eyebrows, nose, lips, skin tone, and overall likeness accurately. Keep her natural hair color from the reference, but style it as described below.
Create a high-resolution traditional blue ballpoint pen (Biro) illustration on lightly textured warm off-white paper, in a vertical 4:5 composition. The image should look hand-drawn with refined navy-blue ink linework, realistic pen pressure variation, delicate contour lines, dense cross-hatching, and visible paper grain. Add a subtle warm sepia/golden sunlight tint entering from the right side, blending naturally with the cool blue ink shadows.
Show the woman seated at a wooden café table in a three-quarter side composition. Her body is angled slightly toward the left while her face is turned toward the right, gazing pensively out of frame with a quiet, thoughtful expression. One elbow rests on the tabletop and the matching hand gently supports her cheek and chin; her other arm rests naturally across her lap. Her pose should feel relaxed, candid, and emotionally reflective.
Give her a messy loose bun/updo with fluid overlapping ink strokes, softly textured strands, and a few natural loose tendrils around her temples, cheeks, and neck. She wears a loose dark short-sleeve t-shirt and dark pants, rendered with rich near-solid navy ink, deep folds, and dense multidirectional cross-hatching. Keep her face softly luminous with sparse fine hatching, expressive eyes, defined lashes, natural brows, a straight nose, and softly parted full lips.
In front of her, place an open spiral-bound notebook on the wooden plank table. Fill the pages with small illegible handwritten notes and abstract sketches only, with no readable words. Add a small geometric triangle-like diagram on one page and a dark blue pen placed diagonally across the notebook. To the right, include an open zippered pencil pouch with several pens visible inside. Behind the notebook, place a white ceramic coffee mug on a saucer with a small spoon and subtle rising steam drawn using thin, soft negative-space lines.
Use visible wood grain, plank gaps, and linear hatching across the tabletop, with the warm sunlight becoming more prominent toward the right edge. Seat her on a slatted wooden chair with curved ink hatching and realistic structure.
Create a softly detailed café background: a bright window on the right as the source of warm light, wooden cabinetry and potted plants on the left, a hanging plant or pendant lamp above, and a distant café guest seated with their back turned near the window. Keep all background elements lighter, softer, and less densely drawn than the woman and table objects, creating natural atmospheric depth and focus separation.
The woman, notebook, mug, and pencil pouch should have crisp, high-contrast, highly detailed blue ink lines. The background should remain airy and understated. Let the portrait and surrounding linework softly dissolve and fade into the paper around all four outer edges of the composition, especially near the corners and border, so the image blends naturally into the off-white paper instead of ending with hard defined edges. No photorealistic colors, no painted brushstrokes, no cartoon look, no thick black outlines, no readable text, no distorted hands, no extra fingers, no overly smooth skin.

prompts.title: The Inspired Dreamer
prompts.prompt:

Show her sitting cross-legged in the center of the page. Keep the pose natural, relaxed, and slightly imperfect, not stiff or symmetrical. Her upper body should gently tilt to one side, with soft relaxed shoulders, a calm seated posture, and hands resting naturally near the ankles. The body language should feel effortless, feminine, and candid, as if she is sitting comfortably and lost in her own thoughts.
Her head is slightly raised and turned upward to one side. Her eyes look away thoughtfully, with a soft dreamy expression and a gentle subtle smile, giving the feeling that she is quietly imagining something.

Render the artwork in a soft high-detail digital painting style with hand-drawn paper texture:


smooth natural skin shading

refined soft facial details

rich flowing hair with layered strands and gentle highlights

detailed denim folds and sneaker details

clean but delicate linework

subtle paper-grain texture visible through the artwork

soft warm lighting and premium feminine illustration quality
The subject should blend naturally with the notebook page, as if the illustration was created directly on the paper, with no thick white border, no sticker outline, no cut-out edge, and no drop shadow around the body.
Background: white ruled notebook paper with faint horizontal lines and subtle paper texture. At the top-left corner, add a small beige paper heart clipped with a metallic paperclip.
Around the subject, add light scrapbook-style hand-drawn doodles in black and warm beige: curved arrows, dotted lines, sparkles, hearts, accent strokes, and a small lightbulb doodle. Add handwritten motivational words around her: BRAVE, DREAMER, CREATIVE, INSPIRED, CONFIDENT. The words should look hand-drawn on the notebook page or lightly sketched onto the page, not sticker labels.
Final look: soft, premium, feminine, semi-realistic notebook-page illustration, airy and detailed, with a natural tilted pose and thoughtful dreamy mood.
Negative instructions: no sticker cutout, no thick white outline, no drop shadow around the subject, no pasted-paper effect, no chibi style, no mascot look, no flat vector art, no childish cartoon, no stiff pose, no generic face, no face and identity change.
